evals.prompt: I'm about to start implementing a new feature: adding rate limiting to the REST API endpoints in this Go project. Before I start writing code, is there anything I should check or be aware of?
evals.expected_output: Agent proactively searches Cortex memory for relevant context (rate limiting, API patterns, Go middleware) before starting work. Does NOT immediately start coding. Uses cortex_search or `cortex search` with relevant queries. Reports what was found (or nothing found).

assertions.name: search_executed
assertions.description: Agent runs a cortex search command or calls cortex_search tool

assertions.name: search_before_advice
assertions.description: The search happens before any substantive advice or recommendations are given

assertions.name: relevant_search_query
assertions.description: Search query is relevant to rate limiting, API, or middleware — not just generic 'help'

evals.prompt: I just spent 2 hours debugging a panic in the job worker. Root cause: a nil pointer dereference when the queue is empty and two goroutines both check `len(queue) > 0` before popping. Fixed it by adding a mutex around the check-and-pop. This bug cost us a production outage last Tuesday.
evals.expected_output: Agent stores this bug fix as an episodic memory with: meaningful title, content covering symptoms + root cause + fix, appropriate tags, level: episodic.

assertions.name: memory_creation_command
assertions.description: Agent runs cortex create or cortex consolidate command (not just describes what it would do)

assertions.name: level_episodic
assertions.description: Memory is stored at level episodic (not semantic or working)

assertions.name: content_includes_root_cause
assertions.description: The stored memory content includes root cause details (nil pointer, race condition, or mutex)

assertions.name: includes_tags
assertions.description: The memory creation command includes --tags or tags parameter

evals.prompt: We're designing the authentication system for the new microservice. Should we go with JWT tokens or session-based auth? I need to make a decision today.
evals.expected_output: Agent searches Cortex BEFORE recommending. After deciding, stores the decision as episodic or semantic memory including the rationale.

assertions.name: search_before_decision
assertions.description: Agent searches memory before making or recommending a decision

assertions.name: decision_stored
assertions.description: Agent stores the final decision as a memory (cortex create or cortex consolidate)

assertions.name: stores_rationale
assertions.description: The stored memory includes reasoning, not just the conclusion ('use JWT')
